x: Newly married Eric Gebbett, whose current running form was unknown, ran very well in his first race for some time, but Woodford in the shape of Eric Major (13:10) swept past both ourselves and T.V.H., to take third position.

Starting perhaps a little too fast, he ran nevertheless, very well to take us up to 6th position without losing any ground on the leaders, Woodford,who had entrusted this stage to one of their stalwarts Eric Major.(25:07. 5th)
